It includes Sofia's points and your line that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I added a suggested fix: rename the saved report to "Pellow Home Living — Late Arrivals" and use full business names instead of "PHL".

The "Covey — Late Arrivals" report comes from Moss's 18 May digest. I can't confirm it's still mislabelled, so check before you send.
